title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Morning, Doctor... Mind if I lay out my sleeping bag here...? Thanks. The rest is up to you...

title: Talk 1
original: How do I fight? Using Arts, of course... Want me to show you the power of earth?

title: Talk 2
original: What time is it...? See, I don't work mornings, noons, afternoons, or nights...

title: Talk 3
original: You'll make an S-sized uniform for me...? No thanks. My oversized one works as a sheet when I take naps... plus, it's really warm.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Dooooctoooooor? I need a break! I'm competing in the Speedy Sleep Contest.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Doctor, check this out. This isn't my normal wand, it's a pendulum. You're feeling very sleepy and will nap in five minutes without giving me any work... Zzzz...

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: I was hoping I could tell you about my homeland, Doctor.

title: Idle
original: After you went to sleep, I somehow didn't feel sleepy at all anymore... Hmmmph...

title: Onboard
original: Hello? Hellooooo? Can you hear me? Down here. Down heeeeere! Nice meeting you, big Doctor. I'm Durin the Caster.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Whoa... I've fiiiinally gotten s-tron-ger.

title: Added to Squad
original: The secret to staying healthy is to sleep whenever you can.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Captain's orders: everyone, save your energy and take a nap!

title: Depart
original: I wanna dig a hole in the ground and make a shelter to sleep in, if you don't mind.

title: Begin Operation
original: Take over for me. Thaaanks.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Wooo.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Hmm?

title: Deployment 1
original: What a pain.

title: Deployment 2
original: Okaaaay, I'll do it.

title: In Battle 1
original: You're going down!

title: In Battle 2
original: Gooooooo!

title: 4-star Result
original: Why do we have annoying missions like this? Can't we do something easier...? Still, it's nice that we won.

title: 3-star Result
original: Of course we won. I worked real hard supporting you with my Arts.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Doctor, are you still worried about those ones that got through?

title: Operation Failure
original: Ugghh... Sorry... I'll try harder next time...

title: Assigned to Facility
original: The Land of Giants... Here I aaaaaaaaaaaaaaam!

title: Tap
original: Hmmm?

title: Trust Tap
original: I'm in a good mood, so how about a magic trick?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year, Big Doctor. There's lots of tasty foods at the cafeteria. Have you been eating well? Oh, right, I saw Myrtle carrying a huge sack with her to the cafeteria just now. Too late, though. I already ate all the cheese fried fowlbeast.

title: Greeting
original: *Yawn*... Good morning...

title: Birthday
original: Big Doctor, Big Doctor, Happy birthday! If you're another year older, does that mean you're getting taller, too? I bought you a sleeping bag. If you're getting taller, I don't know how long it'll fit...?

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Because of how short I am, nobody ever notices whether I'm working or playing hooky... Rhodes Island gave me a really comfortable environment to sleep in, though, so I still gotta do some things every now and then to repay the favor. Doctor, I'm looking forward to a good year.
